name: Living Spring Convergence · Fire
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 5.94-block radius for 21 s. Every second, on everyone inside, including you (damage and control only hit enemies):
• Damage 2 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Soaked for 12 s
• Light push
• Cold 72: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Heals 3.5 ❤
• Regeneration: +1 ❤ every 2 s for 12 s
• Growth: up to 10 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Stone skin (Resistance II) for 6 s
• Heat: sets on fire for 13.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
self_description:
On you:
• Soaked for 12 s and leaves a puddle
• Light push
• Cold 72: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Heals 3.5 ❤
• Regeneration: +1 ❤ every 2 s for 12 s
• Heat: sets on fire for 4.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
